answer: A occupational therapist registration with case load history works as the gate: cases carried by one therapist across years. Each of 243 aliases needs its own case histories, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The pearl check runs in the open: 243 fakes pay the full price 243 times, one honest agent pays once, and the zephyr trail in the ledger makes the beacon cost visible to everyone.
